project.name: HyperInfer
project.description: A modular Rust & SvelteKit monorepo for building high-performance AI infrastructure. Serves as an LLM gateway with a Rust-based data plane and control plane, SvelteKit admin dashboard, and Python bindings. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start here to understand what HyperInfer is: an LLM API gateway built as a Rust monorepo with 5 crates, a SvelteKit dashboard, Python bindings via PyO3, and LangChain/LlamaIndex framework integrations. The README documents the architecture, crate responsibilities, and implementation status for Phase 1.

tour.title: Server Entry Point
tour.description: The 1421-line main.rs is the binary entry point — the largest file with the highest fan-out (33 edges). It initializes the Axum web server, wires up AppState with Database and ConfigStore generics, registers all REST handlers (teams, users, API keys, quotas, model aliases, auth), and starts the config sync background task that subscribes to Redis config updates.

tour.title: Shared Data Model and Error Types
tour.description: The core crate's types.rs defines the gateway's API contract: ChatRequest, ChatResponse, ChatChunk, Config, Provider enum, Quota, RoutingRule, UsageRecord, and TokenBucket — all shared across server, client, and providers. error.rs defines the three-tier error hierarchy (HyperInferError, DbError, ConfigError) that propagates through the entire stack, making it one of the highest fan-in files.

tour.title: Core Infrastructure: Rate Limiting and Redis Pub/Sub
tour.description: hyperinfer-core/lib.rs re-exports modules. rate_limiting.rs implements token-bucket and GCRA-based rate limiting with Redis-backed RPM/TPM quota enforcement via Lua scripts. redis.rs provides ConfigManager with pub/sub subscription to config and policy update channels, exponential backoff reconnection, and telemetry stream management — the nervous system connecting the server to Redis.

tour.title: Client Library: Making LLM Calls
tour.description: hyperinfer-client/lib.rs exposes HyperInferClient, the main SDK that orchestrates routing, rate limiting, telemetry accounting, and response caching. http_client.rs implements the low-level HTTP callers for OpenAI and Anthropic (both sync and streaming). cache.rs provides ExactMatchCache backed by Redis. This crate forms the tightest cluster in the graph (lib.rs ↔ http_client.rs ↔ cache.rs interconnected).

tour.title: Provider Abstraction Layer
tour.description: hyperinfer-providers/lib.rs re-exports the core traits and provides init_default_registry. provider_trait.rs defines the LlmProvider trait (name, base_url, chat, stream, health_check) and StreamingProvider wrapper — the abstraction all providers implement. registry.rs implements ProviderRegistry with register/get/list/unregister and supports injecting external provider registries for extensibility. LlmProvider has the highest class-level fan-in (6 edges) as the central abstraction.

tour.title: Concrete Provider Implementations: OpenAI and Anthropic
tour.description: openai.rs implements OpenAiProvider with chat_request_to_openai_body conversion and streaming support. anthropic.rs implements AnthropicProvider with build_anthropic_request_body. Both implement the LlmProvider trait defined in step 6, demonstrating the plugin architecture: each provider handles its own API format, request building, and response parsing behind a uniform interface.

tour.title: Server Database Layer and Migrations
tour.description: db.rs implements SqlxDb (the Database trait from core) with full CRUD for teams, users, API keys, model aliases, and quotas, plus RedisConfigStore (ConfigStore trait) and password hashing with argon2. The 4 SQL migrations (001-004) define the Postgres schema: teams → users → api_keys → model_aliases → quotas → usage_logs with foreign keys, indexes, triggers, and the composite index on team_id+recorded_at for query performance.

tour.title: Server Authentication and REST API Handlers
tour.description: auth.rs implements JWT-based authentication with cookie and bearer token extraction, auth middleware that validates tokens and injects user claims into request extensions, plus login/logout/me/change-password endpoints. main.rs contains all REST handlers (get_team, create_team, get_user, create_user, get_api_key, create_api_key, revoke_api_key, get_model_alias, create_model_alias, get_quota, create_quota) with admin_auth_middleware for admin-only routes.

tour.title: Dashboard UI (SvelteKit)
tour.description: The apps/dashboard is a SvelteKit 5 SPA with Tailwind CSS 4 and ECharts. The route tree includes login, dashboard layout with sidebar navigation, and nested routes for conversations, API keys (with per-key metrics), teams (with budget/keys/usage sub-pages), and settings. The api.ts client provides a typed fetch wrapper calling the server's REST endpoints. Sidebar.svelte and UsageChart.svelte are the main reusable components.

tour.title: Infrastructure: Docker and CI/CD
tour.description: Dockerfile uses a 3-stage build (frontend assets with bun, Rust binary compilation with rust:1.95-slim, debian runtime image). docker-compose.yml orchestrates postgres:16-alpine, redis:7-alpine, the hyperinfer-server container, and pgweb for database debugging. CI workflows include Rust CI (cargo-nextest, clippy, fmt), Python CI (ruff, mypy, bandit, pytest, maturin), PR Agent for auto-review, and a Release workflow publishing to TestPyPI.

tour.title: Python Bindings and Framework Integrations
tour.description: hyperinfer-python is a PyO3 cdylib exposing HyperInferClient to Python via maturin. Python-side client.py provides an async Client class with chat/stream/set_mirror methods, and config.py provides a builder-pattern Config class. The ecosystem extends further: hyperinfer-langchain provides a LangChain chat model integration (HyperInferChatModel), and hyperinfer-llamaindex provides a LlamaIndex integration — both published as separate PyPI packages.
